title: Convert a full-generator logical defect into a usable quantum channel bound
statement: With sigma=logical_twirl(rho), epsilon=||sigma-rho||1 and delta_alpha=||L*(O_alpha)||rho, the decoded logical-qubit channel has Fe(I/2)>=1-e, e=(3epsilon+t sum delta_alpha)/4. EVERY purified logical input has fidelity>=1-2e and diamond distance<=min(2,2sqrt(2e)). For rho Gibbs, epsilon<=(beta/4)sum||[H,O_alpha]||rho without an inverse smallest-eigenvalue factor.

requires: Exact logical Hermitian involutions X,Z with XZ=-ZX from ONE common decoder
Faithful rho fixed EXACTLY by the full actual CPTP semigroup, including Hamiltonian/coherent terms
provides: A full unknown-qubit/reference receiver using actual stationary generator defects
assumptions: A dissipative Dirichlet form alone misses coherent rotation
The original maximally-mixed fidelity is not already an all-input statement
Encoder uses the actual rho-derived ancilla, not a native initializer
No detailed balance or Pauli-diagonal logical channel assumed
costs: Acquire/prepare the thermal ancilla tau=Tr_logical(U rho U*) and implement encoder/decoder
All per-site Gaussian seeds,3n clock factor, frequency-integrated jump norms, coherent correction, LR constants, radius and tails
No rapid full mixing, microscopic bath or useful numerical tolerance supplied
contract.units: GNS norm at the actual stationary state, trace norm epsilon, overlap fidelity and full diamond distance; source time t.
contract.obstruction: A logical autocorrelation certificate needs a positive encoder and the actual worst-input conversion.

body: This receiver does not itself establish the static Peierls bound, native bath, efficient Gibbs-derived ancilla preparation or physical gate/control performance. Coherent jump cross terms and the actual Hamiltonian correction stay in the full generator. A finite-radius implemented truncation is another model and need not remain stationary. Read the exact supporting statement and its applicable conditions. Producer review status is preserved; no new scientific audit or producer-code execution was performed for this insertion.
